title: The Deadliest Weapon of the Steppe
hook: A Mongol composite bow pierced armor from 300 yards at full gallop.

scenes.text: The engine that propelled the Mongol Empire from Beijing to the gates of Vienna was the revolutionary Mongol composite recurve bow.
